dialect.jaymoskingdoms.common.captain.ja: Every blow you land on %s, you feel some of it yourself.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.orc.captain.jaymo: Hit %s, it hit you back. Same blow.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.captain.ja: Ya hit %s, ya feel it too! Every time!
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.common.captain.ja: %s's cuts close while he fights. Don't let him catch his breath.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.orc.captain.jaymo: %s heal while he fight. Hit fast. Don't stop.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.captain.ja: %s's cuts close up by 'emselves! Keep stabbin'!
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.common.captain.ja: Take a blow from %s and you'll be starving after. Eat well first.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.orc.captain.jaymo: %s hit you, you go hungry. Eat first.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.captain.ja: %s hits ya an' yer belly goes empty! Bring snacks!
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.common.captain.ja: %s's blows leave you caught in web. Carry shears.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.captain.ja: %s gets ya all webbed up! Sticky, sticky!
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.common.captain.ja: %s throws fire from his hands. Keep something wet near you.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.captain.ja: %s chucks fire! Ya'll smell yerself cookin'!
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.common.captain.ja: %s hits so hard you leave the ground. Mind the fall.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.orc.captain.jaymo: %s hit, you fly up. Then you fall.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.captain.ja: %s whacks ya up in da sky! Wheee, then splat!
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.common.captain.ja: You'll look for %s in front of you, and he'll be behind you.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.orc.captain.jaymo: %s go in smoke. Come out behind.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.captain.ja: %s goes poof an' he's behind ya! Watch yer back!
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.common.captain.ja: %s knocks the blade out of your hand. Hold it tight.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.orc.captain.jaymo: %s take your weapon out your hand. Hold hard.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.captain.ja: %s knocks yer sword right out yer hand! Ha!
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.common.captain.ja: %s's blows rot iron. Don't wear your best armour to him.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.orc.captain.jaymo: %s hit, armour go rust. Bad armour, wear it.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.captain.ja: %s rusts ya tin suit! Wear da old stuff!
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.common.captain.ja: %s calls the lightning down. Fight him under a roof.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.orc.captain.jaymo: %s call sky fire. Stay under roof.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.captain.ja: %s calls da lightnin'! Hide under somethin'!
